coverage.description: National AIANNH legal/statistical area components including Alaska Native and Hawaiian home lands; not all tribal land tenure or parcel ownership

published_contract.mapping: Proposed identity mapping of every one of 16 source attributes plus geometry; no added generated IDs; no approved published projection
published_contract.preservation: Keep leading zeros, signed coordinate strings, exact IDs and integer area precision. Retain raw bytes; unknown/unmapped fields fail review rather than being dropped.

completeness.method: Single national ZIP per vintage, ZIP CRC validated, SHP full scan reconciled to DBF counts; no pagination or transfer limit applies to static files
completeness.all_ids_and_attributes: evidence/rows2023.json, rows2025.json, rows2026.json; complete per-record geometry digests, bounded sample geometries
completeness.limitations: No accepted baseline or generated candidate comparison. Geometry digests measure WKB changes, not topological equivalence.

refresh_policy.proposal: Discover annual TIGER releases; stage each explicitly named vintage separately; do not overwrite historical semantics
refresh_policy.idempotency: Proposed URL/vintage/content SHA256 identity; changed bytes at same URL quarantine
refresh_policy.failure: Reject HTTP errors, ArcGIS JSON error payloads if later considered, corrupt ZIP, missing members, schema/ID/coverage drift; retain last accepted release
